items.title: Plaited Wheat Straw Ornament
items.alt: A plaited straw harvest ornament forms an open loop below a woven waist and three upright wheat heads.
items.description: A plaited straw harvest ornament forms an open loop below a woven waist and three upright wheat heads. The open woven loop works as an isolated harvest-craft illustration.

items.title: Wheat Straw Star
items.alt: An eight-point straw-and-wheat star is tied with red thread and a complete hanging loop.
items.description: An eight-point straw-and-wheat star is tied with red thread and a complete hanging loop. Use the complete hanging loop when arranging a personal seasonal ornament design.

items.title: Straw Hat with Wheat
items.alt: A wide-brimmed woven straw hat has a navy ribbon band, a side bow and a golden wheat sprig tucked behind it.
items.description: A wide-brimmed woven straw hat has a navy ribbon band, a side bow and a golden wheat sprig tucked behind it. The hat and tucked sprig suit a harvest invitation or a garden-journal cover.

items.title: Straw Fiber Paper and Wheat
items.alt: A blank cream deckle-edged paper sheet with visible straw fibers rests behind two golden wheat stalks.
items.description: A blank cream deckle-edged paper sheet with visible straw fibers rests behind two golden wheat stalks. The blank paper offers room for a short personal caption or nature-journal note.

items.title: Hollow Wheat Straw Segments
items.alt: Five crossed dry wheat-straw segments show hollow cut ends and a wrapped stem node beside one ripe wheat head.
items.description: Five crossed dry wheat-straw segments show hollow cut ends and a wrapped stem node beside one ripe wheat head. The hollow cut ends make this useful for a classroom discussion of straw as a material.

items.title: Open Wheat Wreath
items.alt: An oval wreath of curved golden wheat stalks has an open center and a dusty blue bow at its base.
items.description: An oval wreath of curved golden wheat stalks has an open center and a dusty blue bow at its base. Keep the clear center open for a short personal title or seasonal message.
